title: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Design Release Engineer (DRE) - Front Camera Module

cond_0001.intro: Engineer, design, and release for production Front Camera Module (FCM) system, subsystems, and parts including camera connectors, electrical harness connectors and vision processors, for conventional ICE passenger vehicle and Battery Electric Vehicle programs. Package, integrate, maintain and test vehicle Active Safety (AS) Front Camera Module (FCM) hardware and software features including Lane Keep Assist (LKA), Pedestrian Collision Mitigation (PCM), Collision Imminent Braking (CIB), Glare Free High Beam Assist (GFHB), Adaptive High Beam Assist (AHBA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR), Hands on Lane Centering Assist (HoLCA), and Drowsy Driver Monitoring System (DMS), using Vehicle Spy, ETAS INCA and Teamcenter tools. Perform physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment. Support software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or related field.
Two (2) years of experience as Engineer or related role.
Preferred Requirements
Experience performing physical testing on components and analytical analysis in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment.
Experience supporting software feature testing by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.

cond_0051.intro: We are looking for an ADAS Design Release Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will regularly work with cross-functional teams to engineer, design, and release Front Camera Module (FCM) systems, subsystems, and parts — including camera connectors, electrical harness connectors, and vision processors — for conventional ICE passenger vehicles and Battery Electric Vehicle programs. You will stay in close contact with engineering and testing teams to package, integrate, maintain, and test vehicle Active Safety (AS) FCM hardware and software features including Lane Keep Assist (LKA), Pedestrian Collision Mitigation (PCM), Collision Imminent Braking (CIB), Glare Free High Beam Assist (GFHB), Adaptive High Beam Assist (AHBA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR), Hands on Lane Centering Assist (HoLCA), and Drowsy Driver Monitoring System (DMS), using Vehicle Spy, ETAS INCA, and Teamcenter tools. You will actively contribute to physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment. A regular part of the role is supporting software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench, and communicating findings clearly with the team.

You will stay in close contact with engineering and testing teams to package, integrate, maintain, and test vehicle Active Safety (AS) FCM hardware and software features including Lane Keep Assist (LKA), Pedestrian Collision Mitigation (PCM), Collision Imminent Braking (CIB), Glare Free High Beam Assist (GFHB), Adaptive High Beam Assist (AHBA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR), Hands on Lane Centering Assist (HoLCA), and Drowsy Driver Monitoring System (DMS), using Vehicle Spy, ETAS INCA, and Teamcenter tools. You will actively contribute to physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment. A regular part of the role is supporting software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench, and communicating findings clearly with the team.
cond_0105.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or related field.
Two (2) years of experience as Engineer or related role.
Experience performing physical testing on components and analytical analysis in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment.
Experience supporting software feature testing by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.
cond_0105.values: We value responsibility, respect, and a genuine commitment to doing right by others. We aim to create outcomes that are fair, thoughtful, and beneficial to the people we serve.

You will package, integrate, maintain, and test vehicle Active Safety (AS) Front Camera Module (FCM) hardware and software features including Lane Keep Assist (LKA), Pedestrian Collision Mitigation (PCM), Collision Imminent Braking (CIB), Glare Free High Beam Assist (GFHB), Adaptive High Beam Assist (AHBA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR), Hands on Lane Centering Assist (HoLCA), and Drowsy Driver Monitoring System (DMS), using Vehicle Spy, ETAS INCA, and Teamcenter tools. You will also perform physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment, and support software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench. People tend to become stronger in this kind of ADAS engineering work over time as they build hands-on experience across systems and testing environments.
cond_0185.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or related field.
Two (2) years of experience as Engineer or related role.
Experience supporting software feature testing by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.
Preferred Requirements
Experience performing physical testing on components and analytical analysis in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment.

cond_0292.intro: Engineer, design, and release for production Front Camera Module (FCM) system, subsystems, and parts including camera connectors, electrical harness connectors and vision processors, for conventional ICE passenger vehicle and Battery Electric Vehicle programs. Package, integrate, maintain and test vehicle Active Safety (AS) Front Camera Module (FCM) hardware and software features including Lane Keep Assist (LKA), Pedestrian Collision Mitigation (PCM), Collision Imminent Braking (CIB), Glare Free High Beam Assist (GFHB), Adaptive High Beam Assist (AHBA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR), Hands on Lane Centering Assist (HoLCA), and Drowsy Driver Monitoring System (DMS), using Vehicle Spy, ETAS INCA and Teamcenter tools. Perform physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment. Support software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of ADAS hardware and software systems.
cond_0292.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or related field.
Two (2) years of experience as Engineer or related role.
Preferred Requirements
Experience performing physical testing on components and analytical analysis in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment.
Experience supporting software feature testing by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.

Package, integrate, maintain, and test vehicle Active Safety (AS) Front Camera Module (FCM) hardware and software features including Lane Keep Assist (LKA), Pedestrian Collision Mitigation (PCM), Collision Imminent Braking (CIB), Glare Free High Beam Assist (GFHB), Adaptive High Beam Assist (AHBA), Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR), Hands on Lane Centering Assist (HoLCA), and Drowsy Driver Monitoring System (DMS), using Vehicle Spy, ETAS INCA, and Teamcenter tools.
Perform physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment.
Support software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.
cond_0322.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or related field.
Two (2) years of experience as Engineer or related role.
Experience performing physical testing on components and analytical analysis in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment.
Experience supporting software feature testing by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench.

Perform physical testing on components and analytical analysis, using Soft Part Release (SPR) and Engineering Change Management (ECM) tools, in compliance with [Location masked] Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) No. 108 Lamps, reflective devices, and associated equipment. Support software feature testing using Vehicle Spy and ETAS INCA tools by reading Controller Area Network (CAN) log data in vehicle and on test bench. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of ADAS hardware and software systems.
